message.content: A magazine cover features a large red masthead "TEMPO" at the top. Below this is the date "EDISI 13-19 AGUSTUS 2012". An illustration depicts two figures and a car. On the left, a man with a mustache, wearing a grey police uniform with two-star shoulder boards and a large wristwatch, sits inside a dark car. His mouth is wide open in a shout, and his right fist is clenched. On the right, a man with short hair, viewed from the back and wearing a vest with the letters "KPK" on the back, leans over the front of the car and writes on a pink pad with a pen. Large white text on the right reads "MENGAPA POLISI BERTAHAN", followed by smaller yellow text: "Ditengarai ada ‘bisnis’ ratusan miliar di balik proyek simulator kemudi." A blue banner at the top reads "LIPUTAN KHUSUS: TOKOH PENEMU". The bottom left corner contains the price "RP 29.700", website and ISSN information, and a barcode. The overall style is a detailed, slightly yellow-toned comic-book illustration.
